fusions.name: Report Clap
fusions.desc: Claps with a report that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Full Clip
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its reach is 40% longer. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crack Decoy
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hair Trigger
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a shot flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
